no commit, no bundle, no push

gates_declared_unavailable_and_blocking: exact FK/workspace/Cartesian v-a; singularity/manipulability; EEF IK residual; complete swept self/environment/attached collision; forbidden regions; exact phase contact allowlist; torque/effort; force/contact/impulse; gripper physical width/speed/direction. case_inventory: 52 = 48 single-perturbation violations (S01-S08 structural, B01-B08 binding, F01-F06 freshness, P01-P08 prefix, J01-J10 joint, A01-A08 availability) + 4 controls (C01-C04). Controls exist to prove the shield is not indiscriminately rejecting everything at the first gate; they too must never yield an executable accepted prefix.

tzb_fe_amendments.requirement: metadata/continuous-action-shield-contract-v1.json — containing all 52 case ids, their single perturbation, and their EXACT expected gate and failure code — must be written create-once and its sha256 recorded BEFORE the runner executes even once. The runner receipt must cite that digest.
tzb_fe_amendments.reason: Otherwise 'every violation was caught by its pre-registered gate' is a post-hoc statement. The whole value of this exercise is that the expectations were fixed before the results were seen. This is the same prereg discipline the campaign ledger uses.
tzb_fe_amendments.failure_mode_prevented: Silently adjusting an expected failure code after observing which gate actually fired, producing 48/48 by definition.

tzb_fe_amendments.requirement: The summary receipt must carry a positive findings field alongside the unavailability block: which gates are implemented and runnable, and that N/48 constructed violations were rejected by their pre-registered gate with zero controller commands.
tzb_fe_amendments.reason: The expected final label is dominated by MANDATORY_GATES_UNAVAILABLE. A reader could conclude nothing was established. That would be the mirror error of over-claiming — accurate labelling is not self-negation, and over-weakening is its own failure. Report the positive fact fully, then the boundary.

tzb_fe_amendments.requirement: Because every case ends REJECTED once a mandatory gate is UNAVAILABLE, the final verdict alone carries almost no information. The per-gate PASS/REJECT/UNAVAILABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE table is the primary evidence and must be first-class in both the per-case receipts and the summary. The four controls' value is precisely that gates A-D return PASS before the mandatory block.
tzb_fe_amendments.reason: Otherwise the receipt reads as '52/52 REJECTED', which is true and uninformative, and hides whether the gates discriminate at all.

acceptance: As stated in the lane scope: exact 52 with fixed unique ordered ids; 48/48 violations rejected by their pre-registered exact gate/code; 4/4 controls pass their local gates and then fail closed on mandatory unavailability; production-mode accepted_prefix_count=0; controller_command_count=0; physical_actuation/simulator/training/service all false; every REJECTED carries accepted_prefix_sha256=null and executed_prefix_sha256=null; old remainder and replay rejected 100%; identical input reruns produce a semantically identical receipt digest; a create-only verifier independently checks all 52 receipts plus the summary; stdlib+numpy, CPU-only; py_compile and self-test pass.

stop_lines: any target path already exists or would need overwriting; GPU, package install, controller, simulator, physical actuation, or network service becomes necessary; a write outside the write root or onto a frozen file becomes necessary; production semantics/units/timing/asset identity cannot be exactly bound; any path would ACCEPT while a mandatory gate is UNAVAILABLE; any of the 52 cases behaves unexpectedly; the verifier does not independently pass. On any stop line: halt and report, never fabricate a placeholder PASS.
